title: callista biflora
intro: Callista biflora, commonly known as the Coral Root, is a perennial plant species in the Orchidaceae family. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Callista biflora are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and display anti-cancer activities. Bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids have been identified as the primary bioactive compounds responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
